verdicts.evidence: isAgentMode has one caller, readRatification, and it passes a mode already trimmed (`(m[3].match(/mode: (.+)$/) ?? [, ""])[1].trim()`): the function's own trim never meets surrounding whitespace. Measured: 0 of 21 cases differ, including the agent traces of `reg`. Positive control: `=== "agent"` replaced by `=== "agentx"` in isAgentMode changes 9 cases (the exit of check --strict --json and the ratification counts). Behaviour probe 2026-09-29 (scratch recipe, reproduced in the PR): eight missions built on the shipped example with the pristine 0.42.3-dev build: `plain`; `reg`, the regulated tier with agent ratification opted in and one trace for each of the seven unbound causes; `nolock`, `badlock` and `nulllock` (scaffold-lock.json absent, unparseable, the literal `null`); `props`, proposals of every shape (ADR-only, file plus ADR, test pointer, missing file, directory); `sig`, an uncompilable and a catastrophic signature; `scaffold`, the charter reset to the template. Each mutant was spliced alone into dist/lib, serially, and 21 commands were run on a fresh copy of the mission (check --strict with and without --json, ratify --list with and without --json, ratify --decided --list --json, ratify --accept by an agent, ratify --decided --accept, ratify --attest-blind, propose), exit code, stdout and stderr compared byte for byte with the pristine build; all 21 cases are deterministic (two identical baselines). Survived the CI unit pass on this branch (mode=measure, commit f68895f, run 36487635757), which includes the six direct test files added for 0.42.3, and the whole-net pass of 2026-09-28 against net 2102deca2908 (scripts/mutation-wholenet.mjs, seven legs, serial): no leg differs.
